title: Composition counit square at one affine spectrum complex
statement: Let $X,X\prime$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $g:X\prime\to X$. Choose the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and the pinned derived counits $\epsilon_f$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. For an arbitrary cochain complex $P$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules set $j=X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $j\prime=X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}(g_{\mathrm{top}})$ and $a=T(s,j)^{-1}T(j\prime,g,sj)$, where $T$ is the pinned underived composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] and the second comparison uses inverse-spectrum naturality. If $\alpha:L_s\circ L_j\simeq L_{j\prime}\circ L_g$ is the pinned affine-spectrum derived comparison [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates], then $L_s(\epsilon_{j,P})\,\epsilon_{s,j^*P}\,Q(a_P)=\alpha_{Q(P)}\,L_{j\prime}(\epsilon_{g,P})\,\epsilon_{j\prime,g^*P}$. No K-flatness, coefficient morphism, or representative isomorphism is assumed.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-pullback-composition (Tag 0D5S); counit factorization of the selected composition comparison

proof.text: For each composable pair f,g evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift equation for the selected derived comparison at the homotopy image of P. The leftDerived_fac_app equation expresses comparison followed by total counit as the derived image of the first counit, the second counit and Q of the inverse underived comparison. The pinned adjunction conjugates commute with inversion, and pushforwardCongr rfl is the identity. This identifies the underived comparison with the inverse of tensorPullbackCompositionIso.

Apply this identity to (Spec.map g.appTop, X.isoSpec.inv) and (Xprime.isoSpec.inv,g). Transport the second identity along isoSpec_inv_naturality, identifying both total pullbacks and both total counits. Cancel the invertible second derived comparison and first underived comparison. The quotient/localization comparison has identity components; its naturality identifies Qh of the termwise comparison with Q of the same map. This gives the stated square, without inverting any counit.
